## Appearance

Matthew is an odd-looking personage with an ungainly figure, stooping shoulders, and kindly brown eyes that gleam with pride. He has long, iron-gray hair that touches his shoulders, along with a full, soft brown beard.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034)_

## Personality

Matthew is a remarkably shy and reticent man who hates being among strangers and harbors a mortal dread of little girls. Known for his quiet and non-confrontational nature, he rarely talks back or seeks excitement, yet he possesses a wise, patient, and good-natured temperament that makes him a sympathetic listener. Though typically unobservant, he holds fast to his opinions with an incredible silent persistency that is hard to argue against. He is an exceptionally hardworking individual who is admired for his gentle, supportive presence, even offering shy encouragement and admiring accounts of schoolwork. Ultimately, he is disposed to keep [Anne](../character/anne.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) despite his usual aversion to young girls.

## History

Matthew grew up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and lived there into adulthood, having worn a full, soft brown beard since his twenties. When he drove [Anne](../character/anne.md) to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the first time, he found himself wishing to keep the young orphan girl despite a mix-up in her adoption. He strongly advocated for [Anne](../character/anne.md) to stay, eventually convincing his sister [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let her remain and raise her properly. Over time, Matthew consistently offered [Anne](../character/anne.md) warmth and encouragement, quietly supporting her interests against Marilla's more skeptical views. Recognizing Anne's plain clothing, he secretly enlisted Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) to make [Anne](../character/anne.md) a stylish brown dress with puffed sleeves for [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas). He continued to offer gentle guidance as she grew, advising her not to give up on romance when she was discouraged. When [Anne](../character/anne.md) tied for first place on the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examinations, she proudly shared the joyous news with Matthew and their family. Before [Anne](../character/anne.md) departed for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), Matthew helped her make the necessary preparations for her education.

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--matthew.md)

Matthew and [Anne](../character/anne.md) form an immediate, quiet bond, quickly becoming best friends who share confidences. From the moment she arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Matthew shows a persistent desire to keep her, silently advocating for her even when [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) has doubts about her imaginative nature. Their close friendship provides [Anne](../character/anne.md) with a gentle source of support as she adjusts to life at the farm.

- Friend of — best of friends who talk and share confidences  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008)</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--matthew.md)

Matthew loves [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) easily and without trouble from the very beginning. He enjoys her company and allows her to stay out late talking with him and her friends, standing by her through early misunderstandings and household troubles. His affection forms a warm contrast to Marilla's strict discipline, giving [Anne](../character/anne.md) an unconditional source of love in her new home.

- Friend of — loved immediately and easily without trouble  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017)</sub>
